result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): B places quiet hours directly under watering reminders, explains the public-photos setting better (what others see when it's off), and has clear Notifications/Privacy/Units/Account groups, with the Account card showing a reddish danger border at the cut-off. A puts quiet hours after the weekly email, which weakens their tie to reminders, and its photo explanation says little about who sees the photos; its strengths are the 'Changes save as soon as you make them' note and On/Off text labels. Both screenshots cut off before account deletion, and neither shows a dimmed quiet-hours state or a 'Saved' confirmation, so items 1, 3 and 4 are scored on partial evidence. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A is very slightly ahead overall. Its privacy copy says what others can see when photos are off, it keeps quiet hours next to reminders, and a separate Account section with a red-tinted card is starting to show at the cutoff. B's 'Changes save as soon as you make them' line and On/Off labels are clearer evidence of instant saving, but its account-deletion area isn't visible in the screenshot. In both screenshots reminders are on, so neither shows whether quiet hours get disabled when reminders are off.
